name: template3
description: Destination showcase for corporate travel and team building
system_instructions: Generate engaging travel destination content that appeals to corporate team-building events. Focus on practical benefits, accessibility, and unique experiences that enhance team cohesion.

field_instructions.title: Create a compelling title that highlights the destination for corporate events. Format: '[Destination] for [Activity Type]' or '[Activity] in [Destination]'

destination_paragraph:paragraphs=2.instructions: Paragraph 1: Introduce the destination with its unique appeal - cultural heritage, geography, and what makes it special for corporate groups. Paragraph 2: Focus on practical benefits - climate, outdoor activity opportunities, accessibility, and logistics that matter for event planning.
